title: Doug's jealousy and why Bunn got out of groups
summary: Doug Daniels was jealous of Bunn's guitar-tossing act, and professional jealousy is why Bunn left groups.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: That's just why me and Doug got into it that night. He was jealous because I was getting more attention. Jealous of me.

Because I was getting more attention. I was out there doing my act, throwing my guitar up in the air and bringing it back and playing, and he was just playing his tipple. I mean, shoot, he had no action, you know?
He was a nice looking boy. Light brown skin, nice hair, dressed nice.
Well, jealousy is a terrible thing, because --

It is. Especially in groups, professional jealousy. It's awful. I guess that's why I got out of it, too, to tell you the truth, because I didn't want to hurt nobody and I didn't want nobody to hurt me. That's the reason why I got out of it. And I was right. Instead of staying in a group, where arguments is going on all the time, everytime you do something that they think you shouldn't be doing, they want to fight and go on. I mean, shit, gee, get away from it. You wouldn't go up there and let a bee, if he stings

you one time, go up there and let him sting you again. If I had to be in a group like that, or any groups like that, I wouldn't -- I don't want to be around them. I'Cause that really goof's your mind up. (Unintelligible). I'm telling you.
